text: Kala golluɗo gollal moƴƴal, harondiral e sar'ia, woni gorko maa debbo, hara ko o gomɗinɗo Alla, Ma Men wuurno mo aduna, nguurndam laaɓuɗam, wonndude e weltorgol ñaawoore Alla nden, e yonndinaare, e hawrindineede e peewal. Ma Men yoɓitiroy ɓe kadi njoɓdi maɓɓe ndin laakara, ko ɓuri moƴƴude e kon ko ɓe gollaynoo aduna e golle moƴƴe.
